name: overlay
title: playerUi.overlay
lead: Puts a canvas in a corner of this player's screen, `size` screen pixels square at GUI scale 1 (96 by default, 16 to 511), `margin` from the edges (4 by default); nil where `player:supports("overlay")` is false.
signature: playerUi.overlay(opts: { corner: ("top_left" | "top_right" | "bottom_left" | "bottom_right")?, size: number ?, margin: number ? }?) → Overlay ?
